post_thread_not_found.description: app.bsky.feed.getPostThread when the anchor post's record no longer resolves. Thrown as InvalidRequestError, which xrpc-server maps to HTTP 400 -- not 404.

blocked_actor.description: app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed (and getActorLikes) when the requester has blocked the actor whose feed was asked for.

blocked_by_actor.description: app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed (and getActorLikes) when the actor whose feed was asked for has blocked the requester.

body.message: Requester is blocked by actor: did:plc:2bcz34zy6yiw55lh4itohhka

invalid_token.description: Any XRPC call with a malformed bearer token (bad JWT shape). packages/pds/src/auth-verifier.ts throws this for a token that does not parse as a JWT at all.

expired_token_pds.description: A request handled directly by the PDS (e.g. com.atproto.repo.* calls) with an access token whose 'exp' has passed. packages/pds/src/auth-verifier.ts: InvalidRequestError('Token has expired', 'ExpiredToken') -> 400.

expired_token_appview.description: The same expired-JWT condition, but surfaced by the bsky AppView's own auth verifier (packages/bsky/src/auth-verifier.ts), which throws AuthRequiredError('Token has expired', 'ExpiredToken') -> 401 instead of 400. Which status you see depends on whether the failing call is served by the PDS or proxied through the AppView; socialchimp should treat both as an expired-token AuthError.

dm_scope_forbidden.description: Calling any chat.bsky.convo.* (or chat.bsky.actor.*) method with a regular (non-privileged) app password. Regular app passwords carry scope 'com.atproto.appPass'; only a password created with 'Allow this app password to access your direct messages' checked carries 'com.atproto.appPassPrivileged'. chat.bsky.* is in PRIVILEGED_METHODS, so packages/pds/src/pipethrough.ts throws InvalidRequestError('Bad token method', 'InvalidToken') for the non-privileged case, which xrpc-server maps to HTTP 400. This is a different message from the generic 'Bad token scope' thrown by auth-verifier.ts's own scope check -- 'Bad token method' is the one actually raised for this DM-permission case. Source: packages/pds/src/pipethrough.ts (PROTECTED_METHODS / PRIVILEGED_METHODS handling) and packages/pds/tests/app-passwords.test.ts ('restricts privileged app password actions' -> rejects.toThrow('Bad token method')).

rate_limit_exceeded.description: Any XRPC call once the caller's bucket is exhausted. Headers set by packages/xrpc-server/src/rate-limiter-http.ts.
